description: Returns Overflow drawings by id, up to 20 at a time, as SVG or JSX. Icons and isometric stills of up to 32 KB come back inline as markup. Illustrations, larger isometric drawings and animated ones come back as a download link that works for fifteen minutes, with a curl command that saves the file; the delivery option returns them inline instead. An isometric drawing comes in any of the set page's six styles, facing right or left, and standing or lying where it has been drawn so. An avatar comes in any of its states: a 3D one as a transparent PNG behind a download link, and a pixel-art mini inline as SVG or JSX. Free drawings need no key; the others, the isometric Pro styles and every avatar need an Overflow Pro licence key sent with the connection. Each result ends with the licence terms.

animated.description: Isometric only: the moving version of the drawing, a custom element with its own script, that moves under the pointer. Every drawing of the set has one, the Anatomy figures included, in any style, facing, pose, weight, theme and colours, which go on the element as attributes a page can change later. Needs Pro.

colours.description: Isometric yours only: its four colours as #rrggbb, ink (#16161a), faces (#fcfaf4), plinth (#c2d2c3), accent (#f2704a), the set page's defaults, which any left out keep.

delivery.description: auto: inline for icons, mini avatars and isometric stills of up to 32 KB, a link for the rest. Or inline, or link. A 3D avatar is always a link.

facing.description: Isometric only: which way the drawing faces. Left turns it round with its print still reading from the left; a sign, such as an arrow or a check, stays as drawn.

format.description: svg, or jsx: the same markup with React attribute names, to paste into a component.

ids.description: Drawing ids, such as icon/calendar, illustration/office-club/teamwork, isometric/240/crate, avatar/penguin or avatar/penguin-mini.

pose.description: Isometric only: as drawn, or standing or lying where the drawing has been drawn in that pose too; a search result lists a drawing's poses.

size.description: 3D avatars only: the PNG's width and height in pixels.

states.description: Avatars only: which of its states to fetch, one file each: ready, reading, working, waiting, done, stuck, off.

style.description: Icons and illustrations: regular, the default, or duotone with a second, lighter tone. Isometric drawings: stroke, two-tone, duotone, fill, anatomy, yours, as on the set page, stroke by default; duotone, fill, anatomy need Pro, and yours takes the colours option.

theme.description: Isometric only: colours for a light page or a dark one.

weight.description: Isometric only: the line weight, 0.5, 1 or 1.5. Duotone and fill have no lines.
